Nicktoons.uk.desc: Dave's old high school visits in 'The Dinner', then in 'The Tour', The Chipmunks can't wait to go on a World tour until Theodore and Alvin realize what they'll be leaving behind.

Nicktoons.uk.desc: Theodore's teddy bear gets bear-napped in 'Switcheroo', and in 'The Paperboy', when Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Dave's amnesia lets the boys skip school for skiing in 'Dave Rebooted', then in 'Germs', ,Theodore fears germs after a school talk.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Simon moves into a tree for some alone time in 'Back To Basics', then in 'Report Cards', Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything to catch the mail before Dave sees it.
